get.summary: Lists every vocabulary with its allowed values and their definitions.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

200.description: Every vocabulary, each with its values in the schema's order.

put.summary: Changes a version's status. Leaving draft runs the kind's publication rules; publishing stamps the publication time.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant that owns the version.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: A `version_kind` value, such as `dimension_version`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The version's surrogate key.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The transition applied; the body is the version's new state.

400.description: The kind or the target status is not a known value.

409.description: The lifecycle does not allow moving from the current status to the target; the detail names both.

422.description: Publication rules rejected the version and its status is unchanged; `violations` lists why.

get.summary: Lists every tenant for a SystemAdmin, otherwise only the caller's own tenant. Connection strings are never included.

get.summary: Returns the caller's subject, tenant and SystemAdmin role.

401.description: The request has no valid bearer token.

403.description: The caller's token names another tenant and lacks the SystemAdmin role.

200.description: The picker's items, sorted by key unless the kind has a natural order (versions, levels, members).

400.description: The kind is not a `lookup_kind` value, or a child kind has no `parentId`.

memberId.description: The member assigned to the band.

upperDecimal.description: Decimal upper boundary; null means unbounded.

upperInclusive.description: Whether the upper boundary is included.

bands.description: The bands in evaluation order; each band's ordinal is its position, starting at 1.

tenantId.description: The caller's tenant when the token carries exactly one non-blank tenant claim; otherwise null.

values.description: The allowed values, in the schema's order.

value.description: The value exactly as stored in the metadata column.
